verdict.rationale: Highnote documents rule-based automation that runs without human intervention: spend rules and velocity controls automatically approve/restrict authorizations, collaborative authorization enforces business logic in real time, cards are issued per-agent/workflow and auto-close when the workflow ends, and webhooks push events for downstream automation. These are first-party docs describing persistent background policy enforcement, matching the 'autonomous background automation' story within the payments domain. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably in production at scale, and evidence of general-purpose scheduling/triggers beyond transaction-time rules.
